import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    static class Mint {
        private int val;
        private static int MOD;

        public static void setMod(int mod) { MOD = mod; }
        public static int getMod() { return MOD; }

        public Mint(int v) {
            this.val = (v % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        public Mint(long v) {
            this.val = (int)((v % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        public int value() { return val; }

        public Mint add(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((long)val + other.val);
        }
        public Mint subtract(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((long)val - other.val);
        }
        public Mint multiply(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((long)val * other.val);
        }
        public Mint divide(Mint other) {
            return multiply(other.inverse());
        }
        public Mint inverse() {
            return new Mint(modInverse(val, MOD));
        }
        public Mint negate() {
            return new Mint(-val);
        }

        private static int modInverse(int a, int mod) {
            int t = 0, newt = 1;
            int r = mod, newr = a;
            while (newr != 0) {
                int quotient = r / newr;
                int temp = t - quotient * newt;
                t = newt;
                newt = temp;
                temp = r - quotient * newr;
                r = newr;
                newr = temp;
            }
            if (r > 1) throw new ArithmeticException("Inverse does not exist");
            if (t < 0) t += mod;
            return t;
        }

        public static Mint pow(Mint a, long e) {
            Mint res = new Mint(1);
            Mint base = a;
            long exp = e;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(val);
        }
    }

    private static ArrayList<Mint> fact = new ArrayList<>();
    private static ArrayList<Mint> inv_fact = new ArrayList<>();
    static {
        fact.add(new Mint(1));
        inv_fact.add(new Mint(1));
    }

    private static Mint binom(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return new Mint(0);
        while (fact.size() <= n) {
            int sz = fact.size();
            fact.add(fact.get(sz-1).multiply(new Mint(sz)));
            inv_fact.add(inv_fact.get(sz-1).divide(new Mint(sz)));
        }
        return fact.get(n).multiply(inv_fact.get(k)).multiply(inv_fact.get(n-k));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int md = sc.nextInt();
        Mint.setMod(md);

        // Reset factorials if needed (but we start fresh)
        fact.clear();
        inv_fact.clear();
        fact.add(new Mint(1));
        inv_fact.add(new Mint(1));

        ArrayList<Mint> ptr_dp = new ArrayList<>(m+1);
        ArrayList<Mint> ptr_ways = new ArrayList<>(m+1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ptr_dp.add(new Mint(0));
            ptr_ways.add(new Mint(0));
        }
        ptr_ways.set(0, new Mint(1));

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint addWays = ptr_ways.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r))
                    .multiply(binom(l+r, l)).multiply(new Mint(l+r+2));
                ptr_ways.set(i, ptr_ways.get(i).add(addWays));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint add = new Mint(l).multiply(new Mint(l+1))
                    .add(new Mint(r).multiply(new Mint(r+1)))
                    .divide(new Mint(2));
                Mint addDP = ptr_ways.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r))
                    .multiply(binom(l+r, l)).multiply(add);
                ptr_dp.set(i, ptr_dp.get(i).add(addDP));
                addDP = (ptr_dp.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r))
                    .add(ptr_dp.get(r).multiply(ptr_ways.get(l))))
                    .multiply(binom(l+r, r)).multiply(new Mint(l+r+2));
                ptr_dp.set(i, ptr_dp.get(i).add(addDP));
            }
        }

        ArrayList<ArrayList<Mint>> dp = new ArrayList<>(n+1);
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Mint>> ways = new ArrayList<>(n+1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            ArrayList<Mint> rowDP = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m+1, new Mint(0)));
            ArrayList<Mint> rowWays = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m+1, new Mint(0)));
            dp.add(rowDP);
            ways.add(rowWays);
        }
        ways.get(0).set(0, new Mint(1));

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp.get(i).set(s, ptr_dp.get(s));
                    ways.get(i).set(s, ptr_ways.get(s));
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s+1; d++) {
                    if (i-d < 0 || s+1-d < 0) continue;
                    Mint ft = dp.get(i-d).get(s+1-d);
                    Mint way = ways.get(i-d).get(s+1-d);
                    int add = d - 1;
                    ways.get(i).set(s, ways.get(i).get(s).add(
                        way.multiply(ptr_ways.get(add)).multiply(binom(s, add))
                    ));
                    dp.get(i).set(s, dp.get(i).get(s).add(
                        (way.multiply(ptr_dp.get(add)).add(ptr_ways.get(add).multiply(ft)))
                            .multiply(binom(s, add))
                    ));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp.get(n).get(m));
        sc.close();
    }
}
